issue: NAI edit targets must not exceed the provider total-pixel limit

before.reproduction: Choose NAI img2img, enter or automatically obtain a 1792x2048 target, and submit the generation request.
before.expected: The target is corrected on commit to a 64-pixel-grid size with each side at most 2048 and total pixels at most 3145728; the final request repeats the same validation.
before.actual: The UI accepted 1792x2048 (3670016 pixels) because edit requests incorrectly used 2048x2048 as their total-pixel limit, and NovelAI rejected the request with HTTP 400: resolution and n_samples are above the allowed limit.

adjacent_working_case: A 1600x896 img2img target is already legal and must remain unchanged; text generation, independent layer img2img, selection img2img, redraw, infill, Vibe, and Precise Reference request paths must retain their existing behavior.
hypothesis: NAI_EDIT_MAX_PIXELS incorrectly equaled 2048 squared even though 2048 is only a per-side cap and the provider total-pixel cap is 3145728.
disproof: The hypothesis would be false if any edit request could still leave the final request boundary above 3145728 pixels after replacing the edit cap and applying pair-wise validation at UI/model entry points.
